issues.title: Potential driver frontal airbag inflator campaign requiring VIN history
issues.cause: 2016 Takata PSDI-5 equipment recall 16V-063 described potentially hazardous rupture.
symptoms: No driver-recognizable symptom necessarily precedes crash deployment
Recall may remain historically unknown on an old Saab
issues.diagnosis_summary: Obtain actual 17-character VIN; check NHTSA; request documented original manufacturer remedy/completion history and professional recall status for older campaigns.
issues.correction_summary: Qualified approved airbag inflator recall remedy if manufacturer confirms vehicle is outstanding; no DIY dismantling based solely on recall year.
limits: Age and model-year scope do not prove unfinished campaign
NHTSA lookup not complete for >15-year recalls
Safety-critical SRS work requires appropriate service provider

issues.title: MY2002–08 9-5 historic A-pillar occupant protection campaign
issues.cause: 2008 federal FMVSS 201 compliance finding at A-pillar interior-impact point.
symptoms: Past installed trim may look normal without repair records
issues.diagnosis_summary: Cross-reference GM/Saab campaign E080101 / 15204 and NHTSA 08V-160 for exact VIN with archived service evidence.
issues.correction_summary: Confirm documented factory A-pillar energy-absorbing trim remedy and professional replacement status rather than ordering cosmetic trim by model year.
limits: NHTSA broader MY2002–08 and narrower 2006–08 owner letter must remain separate
Current stock and service channel unknown

issues.title: US/CA 2008 9-5 automatic-fluid change appears at two inconsistent milestones
issues.cause: Separate original annual-work list and 60k US/CA checklist do not provide one uncontested trigger.
symptoms: A used automatic may have no dated ATF history
60,000-mile service includes fluid change while annual list says 70,000 miles/5 years
issues.diagnosis_summary: Preserve source conflict, identify exact fitted gearbox and factory booklet/edition, compare receipts and independent fluid condition before planning servicing.
issues.correction_summary: Do not claim either interval definitively supersedes the other; use original owner booklet and qualified gearbox-specific verification.
limits: Not permission to substitute fluid specification
Does not establish gearbox mechanical health

issues.title: 9-3 convertible driver retractor recall must not be applied to sedans
issues.cause: Driver retractor automatic tensioning cable may break in MY2004–11 9-3 convertible population.
symptoms: Driver seat belt may stop retracting properly
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm model, body style, VIN, seat belt condition, archived campaign 14222 history.
issues.correction_summary: Qualified recall driver retractor replacement only where documented applicable; passenger coverage is a distinct programme.
limits: Body-style-only; not a universal NG9-3 sedan claim
Do not extrapolate lifetime passenger coverage into verified free work today
